title: Role scope and stance jobs for Spec delivery
question: How do scoped roles and composable stances coordinate parallel Spec and Task delivery?
answer: Role defines scope: Director covers project and integration, Dispatcher one Spec and its branch, Worker one Task. Spec Planner and Spec Manager are separate Dispatcher-usable stances with separate Specs. Planner prepares small parallel vertical slices and may use Workers to author Tasks; Manager dispatches and monitors execution. Reviewer and Auditor remain stances. Director coordinates cross-Spec work.
